0022600171.text: The Toronto Raptors (3-3, losers of their last two, and 1-2 on the road) visit the LA Clippers (1-5, on a five-game losing streak, and 0-4 on the road) in the Raptors' seventh game of the season. Toronto is missing Kawhi Leonard (out, knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (out, foot fracture), and Jakob Poeltl (shoulder inflammation) and Scottie Barnes (hip soreness) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. LA is without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Derrick Jones Jr. (knee soreness), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Rui Hachimura (quadriceps bruise), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), all out, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after the Raptors lost both 2025-26 meetings, most recently 119-94 in Los Angeles on March 25, 2026.
